lines.en: Blade glints as the prisoner approaches.
Footsteps, metal scrape.
Growling low, the knife-wielding prisoner closes in.
Blade glitters under moonlight.
Prisoner swings the knife.
Blade scrapes the ground.
Knife glints in the dark.
Prisoner's steps heavy.
Knife points at the ground.
Blade reflects the firelight.
My shackles still drag on the ground.
I drag my blade's spine along the stone.
Prisoner waits in the shadows.
Hands tightly grip the blade.
Blade glints, silent wait.
Prisoner looks at the ground.
Blade glitters in the prisoner's hand.
Knife points to the distance.
Silent knife-wielding prisoner.
Blade turns in hand.
Prisoner's gaze sharp.
Blade is tightly gripped.
My prison rags are still stained with blood.
I count the notches on the wall.
The sound of sharpening echoes in the cave.
I am waiting for the next prison meal.
Knife points at the player.

lines.zh: 囚徒的眼睛紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Prisoner's eyes fixed on the player.
Blade glints in the dark.
Blade reflects light.
Blade searches the player.
Knife points at the player.
Prisoner stares at the player.
Blade edges between fingers.
Prisoner's gaze intense.
Blade shimmers with cold light.

lines.zh: 你的脖子正好在刀口高度。
lines.en: Your neck sits right at blade height.
That flesh looks fresher than prison food.
Were you thrown down here too?
Someone down here isn't locked up.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有钥匙。
lines.en: I watch your hands for a key.

lines.zh: 别站在火把照不到的地方。
lines.en: Don't stand where the torchlight fails.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势太放松了。
lines.en: You walk far too relaxed for this place.
The blade's edge already points at you.
A thin edge cuts deep.
That shadow behind you is mine.
Blood drips from the wound.
The knife wound on my arm hurts.
The blade deeply pierces my body.
The wound starts to hurt.
New wounds appear on my body.
The knife wound slows me down.
The wound causes me pain.
The knife wound makes him stagger.
Dark red blood seeps from the wound.
The injury affects the Shank Prisoner.

lines.zh: 你散发出的恐惧味道真香。
lines.en: You stink of fear.

lines.zh: 刀是从镣铐上磨下来的。
lines.en: This shiv was ground off my own shackles.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃锋利，适合切割恐惧。
lines.en: My blade is sharp, for slicing fear.

lines.zh: 你会成为我晚餐的一部分。
lines.en: You'll be part of my dinner.
Taste this fear.
Don't try to escape, you can't.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃可以让你体验痛苦。
lines.en: My blade can bring you pain.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，我已经习惯了你的味道。
lines.en: You can't escape, I'm used to your scent.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就把刀给你看。
lines.en: Come closer and I will show you the knife.
Enjoy this fear.

lines.zh: 你在窄道上撞上了我的刀。
lines.en: You met my blade in a narrow passage.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃不会留下任何遗憾。
lines.en: My blade leaves no regrets.
The blade is drawn, step aside.

lines.zh: 刀藏在腋下，一直没放下。
lines.en: The shank stays under my arm.

lines.zh: 让我的刀刃见证这一切。
lines.en: Let my blade witness this.

lines.zh: 手里的刀磨了太久，早该用。
lines.en: I sharpened this shank too long; time to use it.
Don't try to resist, it's futile.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃比你想象的更致命。
lines.en: My blade is deadlier than you think.
You can't avoid my blade.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃将决定你的命运。
lines.en: My blade will decide your fate.
We're the same, survive together.
A blade in hand, shackles on my feet.

lines.zh: 一起分享猎物，增加生存几率。
lines.en: Share the prey, increase our chances.

lines.zh: 你看起来适合成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: You seem like a good mate.

lines.zh: 一起面对挑战，我们能活下去。
lines.en: Face the challenges together, we can survive.
With a mate, I'll be stronger.

lines.zh: 找到一个同伴，共同生存。
lines.en: Find a companion, survive together.

lines.zh: 我们共同面对这个世界。
lines.en: Face the world together.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣，一起生存。
lines.en: I need a mate, to survive.

lines.zh: 只有彼此，才能在这世界生存。
lines.en: Only together can we survive.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响的囚徒紧盯着你。
lines.en: The hissing prisoner stares at you.
It swings its sharp blade.
The hungry prisoner advances.

lines.zh: 我把刀在袖子上擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe my blade on my sleeve.
Madness gleams in the prisoner's eyes.

lines.zh: 它开始缓慢地向你靠近。
lines.en: It slowly stalks towards you.

lines.zh: 囚徒手中握着一把血刃。
lines.en: The prisoner clutches a bloody blade.
The blade slices through the night.

lines.zh: 饥肠辘辘的囚徒扑向你。
lines.en: The starving prisoner lunges at you.
Its gaze never leaves you.
The prisoner leaps to attack.
The blade cuts the night's silence.
Madness flares in the prisoner's eyes.
It begins to track your footsteps.
The blade points to your heart.

lines.zh: 囚徒的呼吸越来越沉重。
lines.en: The prisoner's breath grows heavier.
The blade glimmers faintly.
It seems to be planning something.
The blade is covered in blood.
The prisoner follows your shadow.
The chain reaches far enough. Time to move.

lines.zh: 骨荒原上没人会来救你。
lines.en: No one comes to save you on the Bone Waste.
I will use you as my way out.
My blade rests at my thigh, ready to rise.
You took one more step forward.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的气味把你送来了。
lines.en: The smell of the Flesh Plains brought you here.
Its eyes see only you.
The blade is ready for the kill.

lines.zh: 我等你露出后背那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you turn your back.
The prisoner's breath nearly ceases.
The blade points to your throat.
Its eyes are filled with intent to kill.
The blade outlines your silhouette.

lines.zh: 囚徒的牙齿紧咬着刀刃。
lines.en: The prisoner's teeth bite into the blade.
It has its sights set.
The blade glimmers in the darkness.
Hands first, then the throat.
I wait for the instant you turn your back.
In this narrow tunnel you cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 刀尖已经贴上你的衣角。
lines.en: My blade tip already brushes your hem.
This blade has bitten plenty of bone.
Back into the wall and you are finished.

lines.zh: 监狱的铁锈，还挂在我手上。
lines.en: Prison rust still clings to my hands.

lines.zh: 刀柄在我掌心里转了一圈。
lines.en: The hilt turns once in my palm.
Raising your arms will not help.
This one goes in deep.
My blade hisses through the air.
I seize your collar and open my mouth.
Steel against steel.
The chain snapped. The knife remains.
Sss, feel my blade.
Flesh, my prey.
The knife goes in under the collarbone.
Blade means end.
I have practiced this cut a long time.
No mercy, only death.
The blade is in. Stop struggling!

lines.zh: 你的血溅到我的镣铐上！
lines.en: Your blood splashed my shackles!
I sharpened this blade all night!
Between the ribs is the easiest way!
Fall. No one will bury you!
Hurts? That is the rule down here!

lines.zh: 这把刀是从别人身上拿的。
lines.en: This shank came off someone else.
Hide in shadows.
Darkness is my armor.
Hunger drives me.
Seek prey, move now.
Sunlight's a threat.
Night, time to act.
Wait in darkness.

lines.zh: 我从暗处拖着刀走出来。
lines.en: I drag my blade out of the dark.
Night, my haven.
Another prisoner in the pit.

lines.zh: 我提着刀从裂缝里爬出。
lines.en: I climb out of the crevice, blade in hand.
The smell of rust and blood arrives together.
The cell door opened. I am free.
The shackles snapped, the blade remains.
Chain rattle sounds in the dark.
I rise from the pile of bones.
This layer of rock cannot hold me.
The escaped prisoner has returned.
The blade light arrives before I do.
Flames lick at my prisoner's rags.
I broke my leg when I fell.
Drowning makes it hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪撕开了我的皮。
lines.en: The blast wave tears my hide open.
The arrow pierces my heart.

lines.zh: 魔法火焰烧伤我的肉体。
lines.en: Magic flames burn my flesh.
Starvation weakens the Shank Prisoner.
Lightning strikes me, burning me.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，我的生命消逝。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my life fades.
